Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (21 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.072), which favours a robust combination.
